description: This file contains database migration scripts for converting key-value entries to JSON format within the Superset project, including upgrade and downgrade functions, and custom unpickler class.

classes.name: RestrictedUnpickler
classes.description: Custom unpickler class that restricts unpickling to a specific class for security.

classes.name: KeyValueEntry
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing key-value entries in the database.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Converts key-value entries to JSON format, handling truncated pickle data.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Converts JSON data back to pickle format for key-value entries.
